brief.t: FIRST — Atlas Skin's 2:00 PM ET production meeting today: pro forma PI-2026-0802 (5,000 units at $5.30, $26,500, 50/50 terms) is not Sam-approved and still has three open placeholders — fill size/packaging, billing address, lead time/Incoterms — close them before or during the meeting.

THIRD — new booked call today: Vladimir Elgort of Stellaqua at 1:00 PM ET to walk EDDS-versus-EDTA costed pricing at 250-400/500/1,000 units, biodegradability data, and a mid-September launch timeline.

FOURTH — verify with Diana at ELOIRE whether Sam's Aug 2 reply (a single per-unit number) actually satisfies her ask; the Aug 3 end-of-day pipeline snapshot still shows the full written 500/1,000-unit quote and correction plan as outstanding.

SIXTH — close the loop on yesterday's two calls: review Rehman's Read AI meeting report and act on its items; confirm whether Jarrod/Shay's 2 PM call actually connected, since Sam's last message said he didn't see Jarrod on the Meet yet.

SEVENTH — reconcile yesterday's Gusto payroll ACH debits ($10,233.75 and $3,952.15) against the payroll ledger during today's 11 AM-12 PM Payroll calendar block; do not act on any payment from an email link.

kb.a: Atlas's production/pro-forma meeting is confirmed today, Tuesday Aug 4, 2:00-2:30 PM ET on Google Meet; Ryne Bell and Sam have accepted. Pro forma PI-2026-0802 (5,000 units x $5.30 = $26,500, 50/50 deposit/completion terms) is not yet Sam-approved and still needs fill size/packaging, billing address, and lead time/Incoterms filled in before or during the meeting.

Terra Lotus's manufacturing contract and pro forma await Sam's review and approval before sending. The confirmed scope is 19,000 units at $78,580 total, with $39,290 due as deposit upon signing and $39,290 due after project completion. Logo, phone and email are already corrected, so approval is the only thing left.

Vladimir Elgort's Stellaqua discovery call is confirmed on the calendar today, Tuesday Aug 4, 1:00-1:30 PM ET on Google Meet. He wants a 3-SKU haircare line (treatment-strength chelating clarifying shampoo, EDDS preferred vs EDTA cost comparison, plus daily shampoo and conditioner) in 3oz/8.5oz fills for a mid-September launch. He wants per-SKU pricing at 250-400/500/1,000 units, EDDS-vs-EDTA costing side by side, OECD 301 biodegradability data on EDDS, a timeline mapped back from launch, and PLL's GMP/FDA-registration background.

Sam emailed Diana the evening of Aug 2 with a single number ("$8.20 per unit... please call me"), but the Aug 3 end-of-day pipeline snapshot still lists the full written 500- and 1,000-unit quote plus packaging correction notes as outstanding on PLL's side. Verify directly with Diana whether her request is satisfied or whether the complete written quote and scratch/spotting correction plan still needs to go out.

Victor Armendarez's 2,000-units-per-SKU Curl Defining Cream and Edge Gel quote (4,000 units total) remains blocked. Edge Gel is a confirmed hot pour with a ~$2.90/unit target, but full costing and R&D's written packaging-compatibility confirmation are still not in hand; Victor was asked to check with his R&D lab as of July 20 with no confirmation seen since. Do not price or commit until both are verified.

Rehman Ghani Arain's 10:00 AM ET call happened yesterday, Aug 3, for his 3-SKU UAE tallow balm line. A Read AI meeting report arrived with action items covering formulation options and GCC/documentation follow-up. Review the report and execute its items before the relationship goes cold.

Jarrod Adams/Shay Brands' 2:00 PM ET call yesterday has an unconfirmed outcome. Sam's last message at 2:03 PM said he had joined the Google Meet and didn't see Jarrod yet, with no further message in the thread since. Confirm whether the call actually connected and what tier pricing (500/1,000/1,500 units) was discussed; Jarrod already sent logo/concept files to Laura on Aug 1.

Yesterday's (Aug 3) Huntington alerts show two Gusto ACH debits: $10,233.75 (Gusto NE) and $3,952.15 (Gusto Tax), about $14,185.90 total. Today's calendar has an 11:00 AM-12:00 PM Payroll block; use it to reconcile these against the current pay period ledger. Do not act on any payment from an email link.

PLL's accountant (Austen Malczewski) sent unanswered July financial questions on Aug 3 covering a $49,745.95 Huntington withdrawal (Jul 2), two smaller withdrawals ($4,000 and $1,000, Jul 24), and a $3,788.92 Business Gold Card charge to ISO Group. Aidan and Sam should reply this week with explanations.

Live CRM login was not attempted again this run - the dedicated PLL Consultant CRM account is still pending manager approval with no password on file. Today's pipeline read comes from Sam's own Aug 3 end-of-day pipeline email: 80 active leads (after de-duplication), 7 at 70%+ close probability. Treat CRM dashboard figures (pipeline value, deposits, deal counts) as dated to the last verified login, not confirmed today.

Google Ads API quota was exhausted again this morning (developer-token level, ~9.25 hour cooldown, retry after roughly 3:45 PM ET). No fresh Ads data could be pulled. All Ads figures and recommendations are carried forward unchanged from the last successful nightly refresh (Aug 3, 9:00 PM ET) - they are not re-verified as of today. No Ads settings were touched.

PLL operates at 24600 N. Industrial Dr., Farmington Hills, MI 48335. DTE service is active. UPS, USPS, and Shopify address changes and a test workflow remain pending - no new evidence this run that those were completed.
Command Center v14 is deployed and live. Sam still owes a laptop/TV validation pass of the voice picker and at least one live dispatch to confirm it behaves as expected in real use.
